stage: Full Bonsai fitting, saved-checkpoint evaluation, inference tuning and reference comparisons complete.
warp_backend_scope: Warp geometry, nearest-site queries, FP32 renderer/manual backward, FP16 inference, camera ray generation and RGB8 packing. Original Torch model/loss/optimizer and RoMa preprocessing remain. Warp evaluations do not load the native VoroTracing extension.
limitations: One full fit per backend; no estimate of seed variance.
Threshold crossings are first recorded observations, with no interpolation or intermediate checkpoint guarantee.
VoroTracing and RadFoam use different published recipes and validation schedules; only native-vs-Warp within VoroTracing is the matched implementation comparison.
Numerical masking is counted for both VoroTracing runs. The older full RadFoam runs did not record raw training-gradient nonfinites.
Successful fitting does not certify all WarPower adjacency edges.
Warp fit uses initial Morton ordering in addition to changing GPU backends.
Same-checkpoint rendering agrees; the alternative geometry builders do not always produce identical adjacency. Exact geometric correctness remains a separate unresolved audit.
The L40 measurements do not reproduce the paper's RTX 5090 timing claims or its full multi-scene evaluation.
